cause_quote: `const label = duration ? t("chat.workRun.workedFor", { duration }) : t("chat.workRun.worked");` replaced the operation-count heading while the disclosure continued to render failure counts.
user_saw: The collapsed work summary could show “20 failed” without showing that the run made 200 tool calls.
summary: The fix adds a total tool-call count to the work summary alongside any failure or skipped counts.
reasoning: I checked that the parent commit displayed per-category operation counts alongside the failure count and that those counts included failed calls. The causing diff replaced the operation counts with a duration heading while retaining failure badges, removing the context that the fix restores as a single total.
